post: I'm almost 30 and haven't done anything with my life LITERALLY. Right now I am crying because I am useless. Things haven't changed since I last posted which was when I was 24.. 27 now and my life is still stagnant and I don't see it moving any time sooner. I am still clueless, don't know what's going to happen. Except now I'm now under a lot of pressure because of my mom's health. First of all. I'm 27 never had a job because my anxiety and me feeling clueless about how the world works has held me back. My mom had a heart attack april 2020, she constantly bitches at me about how useless I am, and brought me down so much that I have 0 confidence. I then started talking to a toxic person online and that didn't help either. I just didn't want to be alone. They changed the way my whole brain thinks. I was manipulated and allowed it because I just didn't want to be alone plus it made me feel less crazy and weird talking to someone that was like that. It's hard to explain I guess I stopped loving myself so I just stayed. Well I stopped taking care of myself in like 2014. I havent been to a doctor since 2010. I have a hard time taking care of myself. I don't even know how to make appointments for myself. I hate company when they come over now and can't stand being around people. I have panic attacks. At 27 I should have my life partially figured out but I don't. The only accomplishment I have was from 2013. I watch my siblings all stepping ahead in life. My parents are divorced, we live with my brother. I feel like I don't belong here because my mom says if it weren't for them I'd be homeless and no one would take me in if it wasn't for them. I don't feel good about myself. I don't even feel attractive anymore. My mom always worries me, yells at me, puts me down,  says she's going to die soon within 8 years. I feel like shit because I don't want that to happen and feel like if she does I'll be at fault, I want to kill myself because of her. She says I add nothing but stress to her life, and pretty much begs me to get out there and as stupid as it sounds I can't and won't. I am not normal, so please don't judge me. I don't need to hear that because I know. I just want to know if anyone else in my situation so I don't feel alone. At the same time. I wasn't always like this. I used to go out. Didn't suffer anxiety as bad and didn't have agoraphobia, or scared of company, but my family put me down a lot and bullied, made me feel unloved  in the past, it still happens today. but they don't see any issue in their behavior. My mom gaslit me a lot whenever I open up about how I feel. I get intrusive thoughts where I feel like killing myself is best option because I won't suffer anymore and I won't be a burden to others. I don't want to live in regret and I feel like my mom did enough damage to me, when she dies it will be my fault and I know it's going to be in my head that I could have tried harder for her but didn't. I have a lot more problems I haven't listed because I just don't know what to say or how to say it, but as of right now I feel like killing myself, like I feel like a lost puppy in this world. I would do anything to feel at least happy again and not burden anyone.

People with close families rub off on me the wrong way.. Everywhere I go there's happy families, people boasting, even enmeshment but I lucked out on that department and it's a huge trigger for me. I wish I had the support everyone seems to have because I am pretty sure I'd be happier, it's pretty much what I always wanted. Stability and compassion. I feel like the only one that cares in this family. My siblings are selfish and if only they cared a little bit more about me then I would feel ok. They are obsessed and care more about their friends. My sister always throws me on the back burner no matter what when it comes to a certain friend she sees and she even works with her now. On the other hand I have explained my trigger and hurt with a friend who's incredibly close to his family I believe they are enmeshed. He's an online friend, but he constantly talks about them even though I have told him so many times how I feel. I feel he doesn't respect me enough. I know not acceptable to tell someone to stop talking about their family but it will happen regardless. He even sends pictures and forces me to hear about them. It's like he has nothing else to talk about. My family pretty much it's just me, my bro, sister. My other sister is with her bf and we only see each other often my dad is married and he will always be with his wife and side with her. then my friend his family is always together doing stuff, his sister lives 5 minutes away and she's there pretty much everyday, and I have to hear about them one way or another. I've told him how we are so different and I also kind of wanted to cut him off because of it, because I am trying to heal from this trauma I have and I don't think I could if he constantly brings them up. He says no, I'll stop talking about them but it never changes, and when I try to stop talking to him he ends up making me feel bad. I don't know what to do, like today it's his nieces party and he's sending me pictures of all his family together, the first couple were okay and yesterday he mentioned it was his birthday so he decided to spend the night there. Then today is the party and he's like sending me pictures of his family and niece and nephew. I didn't show I cared or that it bothered me. I am not jealous, this is envy and what I wish I had, but got so closed off from mine after trying for years I now became super anxious around others. I'm not a hermit and don't even like being around people anymore. I feel best when I'm alone, but it still stings at me greatly that there are people out there that are close with their families especially "we" and "us" families. I was forced to be an "I" yet always the one that had to care. Anyone else have this problem and do you think it would be messed up if I cut off an online friend because of this? He was toxic too in the past so it's not like he's been a great friend all along anyways. My family does make me feel suicidal too. I am always reminded of how worthless I am to them, because of them my confidence went down to a 0.

How do people find people who support them, do those people actually exist? My family is abusive to me, and I'm tired of living with them. I have mental illness. Anxiety and depression. I hate being around people. It wasn't as bad as before and I feel like they rubbed off and pulled me all the way down. I am not happy anymore. I don't smile, I never get excited I only fear worried and anxious. I don't like company, but my family always has people around and it's starting to piss me off because I get extreme panic attacks when I'm around people now and on top of that I was brought down by someone online and stood because I was lonely and codependent they made me insecure constantly negged and manipulated me and gave me mixed signals. I told my mom today that I couldn't wait to leave and live on my own. She said "you will never live on your own." She said this to me multiple times and that pisses me off because I really want to leave. My anxiety holds me back because I can't work because of how severe my anxiety is, plus I really am clueless about everything. At 27, I don't have enough knowledge. I feel like I was born to fail, I have a soul that feels like they deserve way better than what was handed. I am not a mean person at all. I feel like I was just made to feel unworthy but I know at the same time those feelings just sting at me. I do see people with partners that see how they are treated and do help them by letting them stay with them and loving them the right way, but then at the same time my mom tells me those people don't exist and to stop being lazy and get a job and do it yourself. At home she is mean to me and she knows just because I am not working she can attack me often by lowering my self worth. I never cared for relationships, but now I kind of wish I had someone that loved me a lot and we took that kind of role. I would love them back so much, especially after I have been healed and feel okay about myself. I was always made to be the one that cared the most even for the people who did nothing but hurt me, I don't want a caregiver.. I just need a supporter and someone there for me and that will allow me to go to them when things get rough. I want a safe place.
